name: eval-as-code-governance
description: Govern a retrieval / ML eval suite as first-class code: decouple gold from the corpus surface (assert behavior via a predicate over stable semantic keys, not doc-ID + rank), then an L1–L8 design checklist, a deterministic failure→action loop, four coverage detectors, the looseness-symmetry guardrails, and the two-lane (component vs production-faithful) rule. Supports design/migrate and audit modes.
